decisions.reason: Process data archiving and reporting software is central to the firm's data-driven, web-based infrastructure strategy and has its own dedicated web page.
This second archiving and reporting product overlaps with A and could be merged into it, but software close to the core offer is cheap to maintain and likely stays.
